name: Forbidden/discouraged function usage
description: Flags calls to functions that are usually unintentional performance bottlenecks. `Debug.*` already behind a simple debug-flag If (e.g. `If IsDebugMode`) is left unflagged.
definition: Flags calls to functions listed in `shared/rules/data/forbidden-functions.yaml` (e.g. slow or blocking native calls), with a configurable severity and an explanatory message per entry. A `Debug.*` call (`Trace`, `TraceStack`, `Notification`) nested inside an `If`/`ElseIf` whose condition is a simple identifier (or `Self`/`Parent`/identifier member chain) whose name contains `debug` (case-insensitively, e.g. `If IsDebugMode`) is left unflagged, since that is already a debug-flag guard; an `Else` of that chain, a negated or compound condition, or a name that doesn't look like a debug flag is still flagged.
